name: @oilflow/mcp-server
description: Verifiable compliance evidence for agent decisions. MCP server for the OilFlow Network APIs: screen counterparties against 8 sanctions lists and a first-party fraud-cluster registry, check trade tradability across 235 jurisdictions, validate letters of credit (UCP 600), traverse UBO graphs, and run pre-deal clearance checks. Every verdict ships with its coverage, its evidence gaps, and an HMAC-SHA256-signed receipt: the signature proves OilFlow issued the receipt unaltered, and OilFlow re-verifies it at /api/public/verify/{id}. Three tools work with no API key.
